_what_this_is: The cases that CANNOT RUN on the current solver and are retired rather than repaired. Alireza's call, 2026-09-20: 'Ignore and archive the unrunnable legacy cases - we do not need them.'
_why_they_cannot_run: S6c-2 deleted the c-based implementations behind five dictionary values. For every case listed here the dead value is refused AND the surviving value's switch precondition is unmet, so NO dictionary edit starts the run. That is physics, not configuration: q_ is assigned unconditionally from theta, so with the content model off nothing solves thetaC/thetaH, q is frozen at initialisation, and the case describes a clot that cannot evolve. Turning the content model on would make each a DIFFERENT experiment, which is a conversion, not a migration.
_archiving_is_a_REGISTRY_not_a_move: Nothing is deleted or relocated. Three of the listed template directories are live dependencies of the pipeline that archives them - AM2020_straight_tube_growth_mechanics_smoke/template IS the main case's template - and ~50 build scripts and 88 notebooks reference these paths. The 146 children are still GENERATED (164 total) so the dry runs and check_runner_staging.py keep their fixtures, and BATCHES entries 0-43 in the notebook keep naming children that exist. What archiving changes is the LIVE SET: check_refused_dictionary_values.py requires every case NOT listed here to construct, and refuses a package whose SELECTED batch names anything listed here.
_a_template_listed_here_is_archived_FOR_: AM2020_straight_tube_growth_mechanics_smoke/template cannot run as committed, and it is also the file the main case's children are built from. Those are consistent because create_cases.py OVERWRITES all five refused keys in every child - asserted by the gate, not asserted here - so the template's own values never reach a main-case run.
_de_archiving: Delete the entry. The gate fails if a case listed here has become runnable, so the registry cannot quietly rot.
